example.title: Frank Pisar (Pisar-Kastanek) farmstead, Quonset machine shed
example.place: Pleasant Hill vicinity, Saline County, NE

brief: Post-war Quonset machine shed about 32 ft wide and 60 ft long, a half-round arch of corrugated steel painted white with a flat framed white end wall holding a big vehicle door and a small window. It stands at the edge of the farmyard next to a round corrugated steel grain bin with an elevator head and a low shed-roofed crib, beyond the 1950s white farmhouse, with shelterbelt trees and plowed fields around.
